description: A friendly, all-in-one IBM i workbench for VS Code with an AI assistant (@vanthrex): connection wizard for several systems, library & IFS browser, edit and compile with inline errors, call graph & impact analysis, Db2 for i SQL with autocomplete and explain, table data editor, debugger, system dashboard, jobs & messages, RPG navigation, fixed-to-free conversion and code checks.

walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.titl: Get started with Vanthrex for IBM i
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.desc: Connect to your IBM i, browse source, compile and run SQL.
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.conn:
Use the guided form to enter host, user and library list. Passwords are stored in the VS Code secret store.
[Add Connection](command:vanthrex.addConnection)
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.brow: Open the Vanthrex view, expand a library, then a source file, and click a member to edit it like a local file.
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.comp: Press Ctrl+Alt+C (Cmd+Alt+C on Mac) in a member. Errors appear inline and in the Problems panel.
Open an SQL scratchpad and press Ctrl+Enter to run the statement under the cursor. Results open in a filterable grid you can export to CSV.
[Open SQL Scratchpad](command:vanthrex.newSqlScratchpad)
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.more:
Open the System Dashboard, check active jobs and answer QSYSOPR messages, search objects (Ctrl+Alt+O) or source code (Ctrl+Alt+F), and edit table data in a grid.
[Open System Dashboard](command:vanthrex.openDashboard)
walkthrough.vanthrex.gettingStarted.ai.d:
Type **@vanthrex** in the chat to explain RPG, write SQL against your real tables, fix compile errors or modernize code. Right-click in a source → **Vanthrex AI**.
[Ask @vanthrex](command:vanthrex.ai.open)
Right-click a library → **Git: Export Source to a Git Repository**, then use **Get Changes from IBM i** / **Upload Changed Files** to keep both sides in step. See every version of a member with **Git: History of This Member**.
[Export a library](command:vanthrex.git.export)

config.compileActions.md: Compile actions. Variables: `&LIB` (source library), `&OBJLIB` (target library), `&SRCFILE`, `&NAME`, `&EXT`, `&FULLPATH` (IFS path), `&CURLIB`, `&USER`. Add `OPTION(*EVENTF)` to get inline errors.
config.sql.maxRows: Maximum number of rows fetched into the SQL result grid.
config.sql.confirmDestructive: Ask for confirmation before running DELETE, DROP, TRUNCATE or UPDATE without WHERE.
config.tempDirectory: IFS directory used for temporary files during member transfer.
config.spool.maxEntries: Maximum number of spooled files listed.
config.autoConnectLast: Reconnect automatically to the last used system when VS Code starts.
config.objects.showAll: Show an 'Objects' folder (programs, files, service programs…) under each library.
config.dashboard.refreshSeconds: How often the System Dashboard refreshes (seconds). 0 = only when you click Refresh.
config.dataEditor.pageSize: Rows per page in the table data editor.
config.history.enabled: Keep a local copy of every member and IFS file you open or save, so you can compare and restore.
config.history.maxVersions: Local history versions kept per member / file.
config.lint.enabled: Check RPG sources as you type.
config.lint.maxProcedureLines: Report procedures longer than this many lines.
config.lint.rules.md: Turn individual RPG checks on or off.
config.lint.rules.unused-definition: Variables, constants and subroutines that are declared but never used
config.lint.rules.long-procedure: Procedures longer than the configured number of lines
config.lint.rules.empty-on-error: ON-ERROR blocks that silently swallow errors
config.lint.rules.mixed-format: Fixed-format calculation specs in a free-format source
config.sourceDates.enabled.md: Read and save members **with** their sequence numbers and change dates (SRCSEQ/SRCDAT), like SEU. Unchanged lines keep their date; changed lines get today's date. Needs a Mapepire SQL engine; otherwise members are copied as plain text.
config.sourceDates.display: What to show in front of each member line (Ctrl+Alt+D cycles).
config.sourceDates.display.enum.0: Show the change date in front of each line
config.sourceDates.display.enum.1: Show sequence number and change date
config.sourceDates.format: Date format: SEU-style YYMMDD or ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
config.conflictCheck: Warn when a member is locked by another job, or changed on the IBM i after you opened it, before your save overwrites it.
config.members.sortBy: Order of members in the Libraries view.
config.sql.scriptStopOnError: Run SQL Script: stop at the first statement that fails (off = run every statement and report failures).
config.debug.port: IBM i Debug Service secured port. 0 = read it from the service configuration (usually 8005).
config.debug.ignoreCertificateErrors: Connect to the Debug Service even when its certificate cannot be verified. Only for test systems.
config.debug.updateProductionFiles: Allow the debugged program to update files in production libraries (UPDPROD).
config.debug.trace: Write a trace of the debug protocol to the IBM i Debug output (for support).
config.connections.keepOthersOpen: Keep other systems connected when you connect to another one, so you can switch between them instantly (Ctrl+Alt+S).
config.callGraph.depth: How many levels of callers / callees the call graph shows at first.
config.callGraph.maxNodes: Largest number of objects drawn in a call graph.
config.callGraph.hideSystemObjects: Leave IBM-supplied objects (QCMDEXC, QSYSPRT…) out of the call graph.
config.ai.enabled: Enable the @vanthrex AI assistant and the AI commands. Code you ask about is sent to the language model you selected in VS Code chat.
config.ai.useTools: Let the AI assistant look things up on the connected IBM i (object descriptions, table columns, source, read-only queries).
config.ai.allowQueries: Let the AI run read-only SQL queries (SELECT / WITH / VALUES only; anything that changes data is refused).
config.ai.confirmQueries: Ask before the AI runs a query on the IBM i.
config.ai.maxSourceChars: Largest amount of source text sent to the language model in one request.

tool.vanthrex_describeObject.userDescrip: Describe an IBM i object: attributes, source, columns of a file, modules of a program.

command.saveToSaveFile: Save Library or Objects to a Save File…
command.uploadSaveFile: Upload Save File from this PC…
config.alerts.enabled: Show VS Code notifications when a job waits for a reply (MSGW), an inquiry arrives on QSYSOPR, a batch job ends abnormally or the system ASP passes the alert level.
config.alerts.intervalSeconds: How often live alerts check the IBM i, in seconds (30 or more).
config.alerts.scope: Whose jobs and messages live alerts watch.
config.alerts.scope.enum.0: Only jobs and messages of your own user profile
config.alerts.scope.enum.1: All users (needs authority to see other jobs and QSYSOPR)
config.alerts.diskPercent: Alert when the system ASP is used above this percentage.
config.promotion.backupLibrary: Library for the backup and transfer save files that object promotion creates.
command.importData: Import CSV or Excel into Table…
config.export.maxRows: Maximum number of rows exported to Excel, CSV or JSON.
config.performance.intervalSeconds: How often the performance monitor samples the IBM i, in seconds.
config.rpgunit.library: Library where RPGUnit (iRPGUnit) is installed; added to the library list to compile and run tests.
config.rpgunit.testLibrary: Library for the compiled test programs. Empty = your current library.
config.selfCheck.onConnect: Check the system the first time you connect to it in a session and warn about setup problems (SQL engine, CCSID, library list…).
config.spool.pdfMode: How spooled files become PDF: "local" converts the text in VS Code (works everywhere); "server" asks the IBM i (CPYSPLF WSCST(*PDF)) and keeps fonts and graphics, falling back to local.
config.compare.maxRows: Maximum rows read from each system when comparing a table across two systems.
command.generateRpgForTable: Generate RPG Code for This Table
command.watchJob: Watch This Job (Notify When It Ends)
command.replaceInSourceFile: Find and Replace in Source File…
config.ifs.followLines: How many lines at the end of a file "Follow File (tail -f)" shows; it refreshes every 2 seconds.
command.copyMembers: Copy Members to Another Source File…
command.outOfSync: Objects Out of Sync with Source
command.bulkOwnerAuthority: Change Owner or Authority of Many Objects…
config.templates: Your own templates for "New Member from Template…": name, source type (RPGLE, CLLE, SQL…), description and text. &NAME, &TEXT, &DATE and &USER are filled in.
config.scan.allowedLibraries: Libraries that may be named in source without being reported by "Find Hard-Coded Libraries" (IBM libraries and QTEMP are always allowed).
command.networkTest: Can the IBM i Reach This Host? (Ping)…
command.callWebApi: Call a Web API from the IBM i…
config.pdm.userOptions: PDM user-defined options (F16): option code → CL command. Variables: `&L` library, `&F` file, `&N` name, `&T` type, `&A` attribute, `&O` object library, `&U` user, `&X` text. Built-in: CB, CS, CC, DF, PF, RS (set one to an empty string to hide it).
config.compileOnSave: Compile a source member after you save it: `off`, `ask` (a notification with Compile / Always / Not now) or `always`. Copy members (INC, RPGLEINC…) are never compiled.
config.compileOnSave.types: Only compile on save these source types (for example `RPGLE`, `SQLRPGLE`). Empty = every type that can be compiled.
config.memberStatusBar: Show, for the member you are editing, whether its program is up to date with the source and who else has it open (status bar; click for details).
command.changedSinceCompile: Show My Changes Since the Last Compile
